items.description:
Amka Products (Pty) Ltd is based at Sunderland Ridge in Centurion and, through its own corporate website, presents itself as a market leader in beauty and personal care manufacturing with a dynamic portfolio of more than 50 brands. Its range spans over 5,000 products across face care, bath and body, fragrance, haircare, make-up, suncare and homecare categories. According to its own materials, the wider group operates 484 locations across five continents and employs around 18,000 workers, with its brands holding leading positions within their categories, including rankings as a top glycerine brand, top female fragrance brand, top bath care brand and top haircare manufacturer.

Operating from its Centurion base, Amka Products forms part of this wider beauty and personal care manufacturing network, producing goods that reach customers well beyond the immediate Pretoria area through this broader distribution footprint.

items.description:
Aqua Maria is a water shop based within the Madelief Centre in Dorandia, Pretoria North, selling purified drinking water to shoppers and residents in the surrounding area. Promotional material from the shopping centre describes the business as a convenient, quality option for topping up water supplies, framing it around freshness and ease of access for customers who stop in for a refill.

As a small retail outlet operating from within a community shopping centre, Aqua Maria serves walk-in customers looking for an affordable alternative to bottled water rather than operating as a large bulk supplier. Its position inside Madelief Centre places it alongside other local shops, making it an easy stop for Dorandia-area households already visiting the centre for their everyday shopping and errands, rather than a destination customers would travel across town to reach.

Arapaho Spur operates from Shop 15 in Menlyn Shopping Centre on Atterbury Road, Menlyn, as part of the Spur Steak Ranches family restaurant chain. The branch serves its signature steaks, ribs, burgers and wings for sit-down dining, walk-in service and take-away, and also offers collection and delivery through its own app ordering as well as third-party delivery platforms. According to the restaurant's own trading hours, it opens at 08:00 every day of the week, closing at 21:00 Monday to Thursday, 22:00 on Friday and Saturday, 20:00 on Sunday and public holidays, and 21:00 over the Christmas to New Year period.

Located inside one of Pretoria's busiest retail centres, Arapaho Spur is positioned to serve shoppers, families and office workers in the Menlyn area throughout the week, combining the familiar Spur menu with the convenience of mall-based dining and multiple ordering options.

ASSEMBLE, based in Nieuw Muckleneuk, Pretoria, is a property development company rather than a letting or management agency. According to its own website, ASSEMBLE Property Developments builds viable, visionary developments intended to create real long-term value for clients and investors, working by networking with specialised individuals and groups to strengthen the foundation of each project. The company structures its approach around four stated core values: a passion for creating environments where people can thrive, continued innovation in development thinking, responsible and environmentally sustainable infrastructure that benefits surrounding communities, and building trust through action rather than words.

ASSEMBLE describes an international footprint extending well beyond South Africa, with developments reaching from the South African coastline to the Kalahari Desert in Botswana and as far as Nice in France, reflecting a development practice operating far beyond its Pretoria base alone.

BA Steel Works, based in Capital Park, Pretoria, specialises in custom steel gates, burglar bars, balustrades, fences and carports supplied across the greater Pretoria area. According to the company's own website, it brings over a decade of experience in residential and commercial steel construction, with every project custom-made to suit each property's design and security needs. Its carport range includes flat-roof, dome and A-frame designs, built from durable steel and premium roofing materials such as Chromadek or galvanised sheets, offering protection from sun, rain and hail. The business also designs steel gates intended to match the look of a client's home while adding security, alongside burglar bars and balustrades built for strength and long-term, low-maintenance durability.

BA Steel Works positions itself as combining affordable pricing with reliable, hands-on craftsmanship for homeowners and businesses needing steel security solutions in the area.

Bamogale Security Solutions is based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, and operates as part of a security group with additional branches in Bellville South, George, East London and Durban. The company's own website describes its mission as going beyond traditional guarding to protect homes, businesses and communities through what it calls ethical, innovative and human-first security solutions, blending technology with trained personnel. Its service range covers static guarding, event security, close protection and armed officer deployment, as well as crowd control and tactical reaction services. Bamogale also offers private investigations, K9 unit deployment, armed response, security risk assessments and ongoing security monitoring, combining physical manpower with electronic systems such as CCTV and alarm monitoring.

With its Wapadrand base giving it reach across Pretoria's eastern suburbs, the company presents itself as a multi-branch security partner for both residential and commercial clients needing a range of protective services.

Banabatau Projects is a CIDB-registered and NHBRC-enrolled construction company operating from the Menlyn Maine development in Pretoria. Founded in 2017, the fully insured business has built up close to a decade of operational experience in the South African construction industry. According to its own website, Banabatau works across commercial, institutional, residential, industrial and retail sectors, handling everything from commercial builds in offices, malls, food retail outlets, educational institutions, shopping centres, government facilities and student accommodation, through to project management on larger developments. Its renovation and restoration division covers new extensions and detail-specific upgrades, including work carried out in live, occupied environments. The company describes its origins as starting with a small team in 2017, built around delivering work properly and treating clients well.

Operating from Menlyn Maine gives Banabatau a central base from which to serve construction and renovation clients across the wider Pretoria area.

items.description:
bb. studio (Beauty and Business) is a branding and web design studio based in Olympus, Pretoria, working on websites, brand identity and content for small and growing businesses. According to its own website, the studio blends strategy with design and creativity to build digital experiences intended to leave a lasting impression, arguing that a brand's online presence is where customer trust is built.

Its web design process combines visual design with customer-experience strategy, covering custom development, secure hosting, user-experience and interface design, and customer-experience research, so that each site is built to guide and engage visitors rather than simply look attractive. Alongside website design, bb. studio supports clients with branding and content work intended to keep their marketing consistent and their online presence memorable, positioning itself as a studio that treats design and customer experience as closely linked rather than separate services.

Bidvest McCarthy VW Menlyn is a Volkswagen dealership on January Masilela Drive in Pretoria, listed under categories including Volkswagen dealer, auto broker, car repair and maintenance, car service and motor vehicle dealer. According to an online business directory, the dealership is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and on Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00.

As a Volkswagen dealer, the branch handles new and used vehicle sales alongside workshop services such as maintenance and repairs, giving customers a single dealership for both buying a vehicle and keeping it serviced afterwards. Its position within the wider Bidvest McCarthy dealer network also means it can draw on group-level processes for servicing, parts and vehicle sourcing, while operating as a dedicated sales and service point for Volkswagen owners in the surrounding Pretoria area.

items.description:
Biotac, based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, presents itself as a leader in dust suppression, developing products such as its Bio-Fusion solution to control dust for industries including agriculture, mining and forestry. According to its own website, the company organises its offering into dust solutions, agricultural and animal feed solutions, and petro-chemical products. Beyond dust control, Biotac supplies fire-related products, animal feed enhancements and fuel innovations, which it presents as part of a broader commitment to sustainability and operational performance for its industrial and agricultural clients.

By combining these product lines, Biotac aims to help operations in mining, farming and forestry run cleaner and more efficiently while reducing the health and environmental impact of dust and related hazards on site, drawing on its Zwavelpoort base to serve clients across the wider region.

Bitline SA Security & Training, based in Mayville, Pretoria, was established in 2001 and has its head office in Gauteng. The company develops and delivers customised training programmes for the security industry nationwide, offered through its own online shop covering categories such as ETDP-SETA training, firearms training, PSIRA training, SASSETA training, in-store services and yellow machines equipment. Its PSIRA courses are priced affordably and can be completed through either classroom-based learning or self-paced study, letting learners fit training around their own schedules. SASSETA training offered by the business spans a wide range of security-related disciplines, including service dog training and care, instruction for control room operators, and paralegal practices, alongside basic and business firearms training.

By tailoring its programmes to individual learners and organisations, Bitline SA Security aims to strengthen the security workforce across the country from its Pretoria base.

BK Electronics has operated from Die Wilgers, Pretoria, since 1979, specialising in the design and manufacture of programming devices for Eprom and Flash memory chips. The company's own website plays on this long history with the tagline that elephants never forget, neither do Eproms and Flash devices, underlining its focus on memory-programming hardware built up over more than four decades.

Alongside its original electronics and shop sections, BK Electronics' site now also features a dedicated solar section, pointing to a diversification into solar-related products alongside its traditional programmer and microcontroller card business. The site offers pricing in both South African rand and United States dollars, reflecting sales to customers both locally and abroad from its long-established Pretoria base, built on decades of specialist knowledge in memory-device programming.

items.description:
Boitekanelo Private Health Care is a primary healthcare facility in Soshanguve East that has been taking patient consultations since 2019. According to its own website, the facility's stated purpose is keeping patients, their families and the surrounding community healthy, with a vision of becoming one of South Africa's most preferred primary healthcare providers. Its stated mission is to provide new and existing clients with personalised, quality care from healthcare workers they can trust, delivered in what it describes as an affordable and sustainable manner. The practice structures its information around its objectives, values and facility details, alongside a dedicated services section covering the healthcare offered on site.

Operating from Soshanguve East, Boitekanelo positions itself as a community-focused option for residents seeking accessible primary healthcare close to home, backed by a team of nurses and medical practitioners.

Boltfast (Pty) Ltd, based in Hennopspark, Centurion, has supplied fasteners to industry since 1983. According to its own website, the company's product catalogue spans anchors, bolts, drill bits, rivets, screws, nuts and washers, manufactured in materials ranging from high-tensile and mild steel to stainless steel and brass. Its range extends to socket head products and roofing and fastening systems, allowing it to serve a wide variety of construction, engineering and industrial applications.

Boltfast describes its approach as a quality promise built around matching the right fastener to each project's exact specifications rather than offering generic, one-size-fits-all hardware. Customers can browse its catalogue and request quotes directly, with the company positioning itself as a long-standing specialist fastener supplier that has operated out of Centurion since the early 1980s, serving trade and industrial customers across the region.

Bonolo Workshops Requisites is a 100% black-owned and 100% women-owned distributor of office consumables based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, holding a Level 1 BBBEE rating. According to its own website, the company's vision is to become the leading, most innovative and transformational distributor within the office consumables market, while its stated mission is to provide clients with easily accessible products that streamline their day-to-day work. The business describes its staff complement as six employees, made up of four women and two men, described as expertly trained within their roles. Bonolo presents its workplace culture as diverse, describing its team as a mix of different races, backgrounds and traditions working together under a shared, friendly approach.

Operating from Centurion, the company distributes office consumables from a range of established brands to clients across the surrounding business community.

Brands 4 Africa, operating from Samrand Business Park in Centurion, describes itself as a house of brands specialising in procurement, full supply chain management, distribution, consolidation and final-destination delivery of building products. According to its own website, the company has built up nearly three decades of experience in the Southern African market, working with established local and international brands spanning bathroom and building fittings, including Aqua Dor, Bijou, Bonami, Cachet Taps, Como Baths, DCLSA, Entree, Knob & Knocker, Kronotex, Livingstone, Meissen and Molinari. Its stated focus areas include sales, brand management and business development, with an emphasis on integrating retail best practices to reduce costs and improve efficiency for customers.

Brands 4 Africa supplies products intended for residential, commercial and public environments, positioning itself as a distribution partner bringing established building and bathroom brands to businesses across Gauteng and the wider region.

items.description:
Builders Choice Factory Shop operates from Erma Street in the Andeon area of Booysens, Pretoria, trading as a hardware retailer, wholesaler and steel merchant. According to its own Facebook page, the business supplies roofing, timber, steel, DIY products, paint and doors, among other building materials, serving both individual DIY customers and trade buyers looking to purchase in bulk. The shop offers customers a choice of delivery, in-store collection or in-store shopping, giving flexibility to builders and homeowners sourcing materials for projects of different sizes.

Positioned as both a retailer and a wholesaler, Builders Choice Factory Shop is set up to serve walk-in customers from the surrounding Pretoria community as well as contractors and tradespeople needing steel, timber and roofing supplies at wholesale volumes, combining a factory-shop pricing model with a broad building-materials range.

BWT Garsfontein operates from Shop 10 in Garsfontein Village on Serene Street, forming part of the BWT Shop network of water-treatment stores. According to its own store page, the branch offers rental solutions, installation, servicing and repairs, sanitation products and water delivery alongside its retail range. Its product line-up includes under-counter water filters, countertop water dispensers and Ecosoft-branded filtration systems, including a two-stage under-counter filter and a six-stage reverse osmosis system marketed as reducing reliance on large numbers of plastic bottles.

By combining retail sales with rental options and ongoing service and repair work, BWT Garsfontein positions itself as a long-term water-quality partner for households in the area rather than a once-off equipment seller, supporting customers with filters, dispensers and softeners from its Garsfontein Village location.

Capitec Bank's Rosslyn branch trades from inside Rosslyn Corner Shopping Centre, at the corner of Piet Rautenbach Street and Kotzenberg Street in Rosslyn, Pretoria. As a branch of the wider Capitec Bank network, it offers personal and business banking accounts and day-to-day banking services such as deposits, withdrawals and account queries to customers in the surrounding area.

Being located inside a neighbourhood shopping centre places the branch alongside other retail and service outlets, making it a convenient stop for banking needs while running other errands. The branch keeps extended weekday hours and is also open on Saturdays, giving residents and business owners in Rosslyn and the wider Akasia area access to in-person banking outside standard weekday office hours, within a retail setting many customers already visit regularly.

Carma Business Solutions, trading as Carma Systems from Lyttelton Manor in Centurion, has provided transport technology solutions since 2002. According to its own website, the company builds ticketing and operations platforms for passenger transport operators across commuter bus, long-distance bus, rail and tour or charter services. Its flagship product, BussPro, is a Windows-based desktop platform covering sales and reservations, point-of-sale ticketing with offline and real-time synchronisation, luggage tracking, revenue accounting and reporting, timetable and fare management, and multi-user operations for high-volume environments. A companion web platform extends the same functionality to any device with a browser, letting operators and staff manage bookings and operations without installing dedicated software.

By combining fleet management, real-time tracking and ticketing tools under one system, Carma Business Solutions positions itself as a specialist technology partner for South African passenger transport operators.

Cash Crusaders Wonderboom trades from Shop G04B in Wonderboom Junction on Lavender Road in Annlin West, Pretoria. The store buys, sells and trades a wide range of new and second-hand goods, including cellphones, TVs, audio and video equipment, computers, DJ and PA equipment, homeware and decor, musical instruments, watches, toys, appliances, power tools, outdoor and sporting goods, gaming consoles and car audio equipment. According to its own store page, customers can also access loans against valuables, extend existing loans, or make purchases through a six-month lay-by option. The branch is open seven days a week, from 09:00 to 18:00 on weekdays, 09:00 to 16:00 on Saturdays and 09:00 to 14:00 on Sundays.

Combining second-hand retail with loan and lay-by services, Cash Crusaders Wonderboom gives shoppers in the Annlin West and Wonderboom area a single store for buying, selling and short-term borrowing against personal items.

Centurion Press is a creative print-on-demand shop based in Wierda Park, Centurion. According to its own Facebook page, the business combines quality craftsmanship with on-demand digital printing and a personal, hands-on approach to service, rather than operating as a high-volume, impersonal print run operation. Working on a print-on-demand basis allows the company to produce printed items as orders come in, which can suit customers needing smaller runs of stationery or printed materials without committing to large minimum quantities upfront.

Based in Wierda Park, the business is positioned within easy reach of other businesses and residents across Centurion who need printing handled with individual attention rather than through a large, anonymous, mass-production print shop, making it a practical option for smaller or more personalised print jobs.

CES Database Development, based in Lynnwood Park, Pretoria, specialises in designing, developing and deploying custom Microsoft Access databases for small businesses. According to its own website, the company helps clients move away from spreadsheets by migrating their data into secure, relational Access databases that can be accessed remotely, supporting businesses that need to work away from a single office location. Its services cover personalised MS Access systems built around each client's specific processes, data migration from existing spreadsheets, cloud-based hosting for secure access from any device, and ongoing support once a system is live.

By focusing on streamlining operations and improving data accuracy, CES Database Development positions itself as a specialist for small businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not need a full enterprise database system, offering a more affordable, tailored alternative instead.

Checkers Kosmosdal is a supermarket located at the corner of Rietspruit Road in Kosmosdal, Centurion. According to an online business directory listing, the store is categorised not only as a supermarket but also as a bakery, butchery, coffee shop and deli, reflecting an in-store offering that goes beyond standard grocery shelves. This combination gives shoppers fresh bread, meat counters, coffee and prepared deli items alongside the store's general grocery range, letting customers handle much of their weekly shop in one visit.

Trading hours for the branch are listed as 08:00 to 20:00. Positioned in the Kosmosdal area of Centurion, the store serves as a convenient, well-rounded grocery destination for households and businesses in the surrounding neighbourhoods, combining everyday grocery essentials with freshly prepared food options under one roof.

CID Couriers, based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, handles logistics requirements ranging from everyday domestic deliveries to specialised international freight. According to its own website, the company's local services include domestic courier runs, dedicated truck loads and domestic air freighting, while its international offering covers international courier deliveries, cross-border freight and import courier and freight services. For less conventional jobs, CID Couriers also arranges special and abnormal-load trips, internationally approved crating for valuable or delicate goods, and home and office furniture removals. The business describes itself as working through an extensive network of handpicked service providers, each chosen for a specific area of logistics expertise, so a single point of contact can coordinate different types of freight and removal work.

Trading under the phrase Consider It Done, CID Couriers positions itself as a personalised logistics partner for clients moving goods locally or across borders.

items.description:
Combrinkium, based in Sinoville, Pretoria, combines traditional print services with vehicle wrapping and protection work. According to its own website, the business prints business cards and flyers, manufactures general signage, and produces large-format banners, posters and canvasses, alongside display units and flags.

Its vehicle and fleet graphics division covers full and partial vinyl wraps for cars, boats, bikes and company fleets, along with wrapping of items such as fridges, lockers, desks, coffins and laptops, plus custom stripes and decals. Combrinkium is also an authorised distributor and applicator of a vehicle dipping finish, offering full-body dips, mag and badge finishes and light-smoking treatments for customising vehicles, as well as a protective treatment covering bumpers, fenders, bonnets, front lights, mirrors and rim guard protection. The company additionally offers a removable rust-look wrap finish, serving vehicle owners and businesses across Pretoria from its Sinoville base.

Common Ground Collective, based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, is a media production and marketing agency built around storytelling for brands and businesses. According to its own website, the company works across videography, photography and creative writing, aiming to help the organisations it works with connect with their own clients on a more human level. Common Ground Collective describes a structured process for client projects: first connecting to understand who the client is and what they need, then choosing the right service for that need, collaborating on concepts, storyboards, scripts and briefs during pre-production, and finally moving into production to create the finished material.

The agency positions itself as able to act either as a dedicated external partner or as an extension of a client's own marketing team, offering video production, photography and creative content services from its Wapadrand base.

CommuTech is a marketing and supply agency based in Pretoria. According to its own Facebook page, the business describes itself as providing marketing and supply-related services while also working to help communities develop, suggesting a focus that extends beyond standard commercial marketing work into community-oriented projects.

Operating from the Clydesdale area near Pretoria's city centre, CommuTech positions itself at the intersection of marketing services and broader community development support, rather than presenting itself purely as a commercial advertising agency. Given its central Pretoria location, the business is placed within reach of clients across the inner city and surrounding suburbs who may be looking for a marketing and supply partner that frames its work around a stated community-development purpose alongside its commercial services.

Cornwall Hill College is a private and boarding school located on Nellmapius Drive in Irene, Centurion, within Gauteng. According to its Wikipedia entry, the school operates as a combined private and boarding institution, offering boarders a residential option alongside day-scholar places. Its motto, Singuli Omnes, translates as One and All, reflecting a stated emphasis on individual pupils as part of a wider school community. Operating as a private school rather than a state-funded institution, Cornwall Hill College sets its own curriculum structure and admissions approach, drawing pupils from Centurion and the surrounding Pretoria area.

Its Irene location places the school within one of Centurion's established residential districts, giving boarding and day pupils access to a suburban campus setting away from the more built-up parts of the city, within a well-known local school community.

items.description:
DB Fusion, based in Lyttelton Manor, Pretoria, is a finance technology company that works at the intersection of finance, business and IT. According to its own website, the company provides business consulting, accounting services, Sage software implementation and bespoke software development, helping organisations automate and integrate their financial processes. As a Sage partner, DB Fusion offers solutions covering payroll, accounting, business management and payment processing, with a particular focus on developing custom integration modules that connect these systems through bespoke automations rather than relying on off-the-shelf links alone. Its service range includes software installation and upgrades, ERP solutions, desktop and mobile application development, asset and document management, and business and accounting process consulting.

By automating routine financial processes, the company aims to give management teams more accurate reporting and faster access to decision-making information across the divisions it supports for its clients.

DBTECH Solutions, based in Heuwelsig Estate, Centurion, is a software development company established in 2011 that builds enterprise-grade business systems. According to its own website, the company has grown to more than 120 enterprise deployments across more than five industries and four African countries, with its work now extending beyond South Africa into India and Mauritius.

DBTECH designs point-of-sale, healthcare, ERP and custom business systems intended to replace manual billing and paperwork, poor inventory control, disconnected systems and limited real-time reporting with integrated, AI-supported tools. Its feature set includes smart billing and invoicing, real-time inventory tracking, multi-branch management, supplier and purchase management, AI-based inventory forecasting and detailed business reporting, alongside healthcare-specific tools such as outpatient and inpatient department management and e-prescription systems. The company covers the full process from system design through development, deployment and ongoing support for its clients' digital transformation from its Centurion base.

items.description:
Dis-Chem Montana trades from the upper level of Kolonnade Shopping Centre in Montana, Pretoria North, as part of the national Dis-Chem pharmacy and retail chain. According to its own store page, the branch offers click-and-collect ordering, an in-store beauty salon, a health clinic and a delivery service alongside its usual pharmacy and retail departments. Trading hours for the main store run from 08:00 to 19:00 on weekdays, 08:00 to 18:00 on Saturdays and 09:00 to 16:00 on Sundays, while the attached beauty salon and clinic keep their own, slightly different hours to accommodate salon treatments and clinic appointments separately from general retail trading.

By combining a dispensing pharmacy with a beauty salon and primary-care clinic under one roof, Dis-Chem Montana gives shoppers at Kolonnade Shopping Centre access to medicine, beauty treatments and basic healthcare services together.

Dis-Chem Pharmacy Lynnwood Lane operates from Shop S101 in the Lynnwood Lane Retail Centre in Equestria, Pretoria East, as part of the national Dis-Chem chain. According to its own store page, the branch offers click-and-collect ordering, an in-store hair and beauty salon, a health clinic and a delivery service in addition to its dispensing pharmacy and general retail offering. The main store trades from 09:00 to 18:00 on weekdays, 09:00 to 17:00 on Saturdays and 09:00 to 15:00 on Sundays, while its hair and beauty salon and clinic sections run on their own separate schedules to suit salon bookings and clinic appointments.

With pharmacy, beauty salon and clinic services available together at Lynnwood Lane, the branch gives residents of Equestria and the wider Pretoria East area access to prescription medicine, health consultations and beauty treatments in one location.

DIY Depot Paynter's trades from Moot Street in Hermanstad, Pretoria, as a franchise store within the national DIY Depot hardware group. According to its own store page, the branch is open Monday to Friday from 07:30 to 17:00 and on Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00, closing on Sundays.

As part of the wider DIY Depot network, which runs its head office from Bedfordview, the Hermanstad branch benefits from group-level buying power and support while operating as a dedicated local hardware store under the Paynter's name. The store supplies general hardware, building materials and DIY products to tradespeople and homeowners in the Hermanstad and Daspoort area, giving local customers a nearby alternative to travelling into central Pretoria for everyday building and renovation supplies, backed by the resources of a larger national hardware group.

DW Motors is a used car dealership based on Soutpansberg Road in Pretoria. According to its own Facebook page, the business describes itself as built around customer satisfaction, framing its role as helping buyers find a vehicle to suit their needs rather than simply moving stock. The dealership's social media listings give a sense of its typical stock, including posts for vehicles such as a diesel bakkie, pointing to a focus on practical, everyday vehicles alongside passenger cars. DW Motors also lists and sells vehicles through its own online store, giving buyers the option to browse stock remotely before visiting the dealership in person.

Operating from Pretoria's city-central area, the dealership serves buyers looking for used vehicles without the overheads of a larger franchised showroom, relying on direct, personal engagement with customers through its social media presence.

Easigrass Pretoria supplies and installs artificial grass under the Easigrass brand, serving customers across Pretoria and the greater Tshwane area. According to its own partner website, the Pretoria operation offers a residential product range that includes the Windsor, Kensington, Kensington Gold, Easi-Pet and Knightsbridge artificial grass ranges, alongside a dedicated Kensington Gold product for commercial applications. The Easi-Pet range is specifically positioned for pet-owning households, suggesting a product built to handle more demanding everyday use than standard residential lawns. Beyond installation, the Pretoria partner also provides information on the benefits of artificial grass and ongoing maintenance guidance, helping customers understand the upkeep required after installation.

As a local partner operating within the national Easigrass dealership network, Easigrass Pretoria combines the backing of an established brand with a locally based installation and support team for residential and commercial customers in the area.
